lines.zh: 四只粉蹄踏过草地，很显眼。
lines.en: Four pink hooves cross the grass, plainly visible.
I step lightly with each stride.
My hooves look freshly dyed pink.
I walk the slope, belly swaying.
Mud does not cling to my feet.

lines.zh: 我走到哪，草就压出一条线。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass bends into a line.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，反正不赶时间。
lines.en: I go slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 从地球版来的路，我认得。
lines.en: I know the way from Earth.

lines.zh: 我抬起蹄子看了看，还是粉的。
lines.en: I lift a hoof to check: still pink.

lines.zh: 田里翻过的土，走起来松。
lines.en: Plowed soil is loose underfoot.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，走它踩过的路。
lines.en: I follow a companion's trodden path.
Sun on my back; my pink hooves gleam.
I go around a thistle; it prickles.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把蹄子在地上蹭。
lines.en: I stop and scrape my hoof on the ground.
Short grass here; I move faster.
My tracks are paler than other pigs'.

lines.zh: 我站着，一只蹄子微微抬起。
lines.en: I stand with one hoof slightly raised.

lines.zh: 粉蹄踩在绿草上，很好看。
lines.en: Pink on green looks fine.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，驱赶飞虫。
lines.en: I flick my tail at the flies.

lines.zh: 我鼻子哼气，吹起一点土。
lines.en: My snout puffs and lifts a little dust.

lines.zh: 我把一只蹄子搭在石头上。
lines.en: I rest one hoof on a stone.

lines.zh: 我听见同伴在坡下哼哼。
lines.en: I hear a companion grunting downslope.
I open my mouth halfway in a yawn.
This hoof itches a little.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，草就绿成一片。
lines.en: I blink slowly, and the grass blurs green.
I am looking for nothing; I just stand.
The wind slips past under my hooves.
I wait for the sun to warm a little more.
Someone hums downhill; I listen.

lines.zh: 这片地我很熟，闭眼都行。
lines.en: I know this ground well enough to close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我原地转了个身，又停下。
lines.en: I turn in place and stop again.
I snort, satisfied.

lines.zh: 你看我的蹄子，看很久了。
lines.en: You have been staring at my hooves.
No food in your hands; I stay put.
I look up — just a little.

lines.zh: 粉蹄是天生的，不是染的。
lines.en: The pink is natural, not dyed.

lines.zh: 你站得那么近，我退一步。
lines.en: You stand so close; I step back.

lines.zh: 从地球搬过来，蹄子没变色。
lines.en: Brought over from Earth; the color held.
I tilt my head at your boots.
You come from the plains too, I think.

lines.zh: 我鼻子凑近，闻了闻你的手。
lines.en: I bring my snout up and sniff your hand.
One grunt, and I turn away.

lines.zh: 我站在你影子里，蹄子凉快了。
lines.en: In your shadow my hooves cool down.

lines.zh: 你看就看，我连头都不抬。
lines.en: Look all you want; I won't even lift my head.
I squeal once and dodge aside.

lines.zh: 我靠住同伴的肩，才没倒下。
lines.en: I lean on a herd mate's shoulder to stay up.
Blood on my pink hoof.
Ten health drains fast.
I pant so hard my snout whistles.

lines.zh: 我缩起一条腿，粉蹄在发抖。
lines.en: I tuck a leg up and my pink hoof shakes.
A companion comes and nuzzles me.
My legs give and I sit down.
I do not want to run; it hurts too much.
One more hit and I go down.
Carrots — I smell the sweetness.
I lift a pink hoof and step forward.
Lower it a little.
My snout arrives before my mouth.
One of these will keep me chewing.
Do not take it away; I have not eaten.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只要你拿着。
lines.en: I follow while you hold it.
The smell makes me forget direction.
Set it down; I will take my time.
Do not pull your hand back; I will miss.
Beetroot works too; I am not picky.
After this bite — is there more?

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭你的腿，讨第二根。
lines.en: I rub your leg, asking for a second.
I eat badly; do not take pictures.
Open your pocket and let me look.
I chew slowly and loudly.
You touched my pink hoof.
I am shorter than you; I cannot win a shove.

lines.zh: 我抬脚绕开，粉蹄没沾上泥。
lines.en: I step around you; my pink hooves stay clean.
Do not step on my hoof; it hurts.
I grunt. Not angry.

lines.zh: 你撞得我转了半圈，蹄印乱了。
lines.en: You spin me half around; my prints go crooked.
We are crowding the same tuft.
I step out of your shadow.
My hoof slipped.

lines.zh: 我抬脚从你裤腿边擦过去。
lines.en: I lift a hoof and brush past your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我把粉蹄抬起来，给她看。
lines.en: I raise a pink hoof to show her.

lines.zh: 同伴在坡上，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: A companion is upslope; I wander over.
I walk half a circle around her.
Nose to nose, and that is that.
I do not call out; it would scare her.

lines.zh: 这个季节，草地上都是猪。
lines.en: This season the meadow is full of pigs.

lines.zh: 我们并排低头，草被吃出两排牙印。
lines.en: We graze side by side, leaving two rows of bite marks.
Her hooves are pinker than mine.
Do not stand there watching. Go.
We wander off into the deeper grass.

lines.zh: 一颗掉下来的苹果，我叼住。
lines.en: I catch a fallen apple.
I root the soil aside.
Small enough to carry.
Too heavy; I roll it along.
I sniff first, then decide.
A grass stem — I chew it.
This is not a carrot.
I pin it under my hoof.
I carry it a few steps and drop it.
Someone dropped it; I will watch it.
The grass tips stir; I stop grazing.
I raise my snout and sniff.
That smell is wrong.
I am not fierce, but I can shove.

lines.zh: 我把蹄子在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: I scrape my hoof twice on the ground.
It is nearing the trough.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我把身子横过来。
lines.en: Something nears; I turn broadside.
I grunt, very low.
If it comes, I run.
Now I see: a wild wolf.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着它，草也不吃了。
lines.en: I keep watching it, and stop grazing.
It circles; my head follows.
I retreat behind a companion.

lines.zh: 它退开一点，我也不放松。
lines.en: It backs off; I do not relax.

lines.zh: 它踏过一丛蓟，我记下了位置。
lines.en: It steps through a thistle patch; I note where.

lines.zh: 我的粉蹄在草里很显眼。
lines.en: My pink hooves stand out in the grass.
There is no fence nearby.
It moves, and I tense.
I grunt to call my companions.

lines.zh: 它再近一步，我就掉头跑。
lines.en: One more step from it and I turn and run.
I shove once, and my pink hoof slips.
That shove did not even flatten grass.
I bite your trouser leg.
I rear and strike once.
I have no tusks.
This is to make you back off.
After the shove I retreat.
Do not take this strength seriously.

lines.zh: 我一蹄子踢出去，落点偏了。
lines.en: My hoof lashes out and lands wide.
I cannot win; I only want to leave.

lines.zh: 我在平原上站起来，蹄子还是软的。
lines.en: I stand on the plains, hooves still soft.
Pink hooves touch grass for the first time.

lines.zh: 我的新蹄踩进软土，印子很浅。
lines.en: My new hooves press soft soil; the prints stay shallow.
This is bigger than the Earth pasture.
My first breath tastes of grass.
Companions grunt nearby.
I try three steps.

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得往后。
lines.en: The wind pushes my ears back.
I lower my head and root once.
The sun is right; I squint.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子被火燎得发烫。
lines.en: Fire scorches my hooves hot.
I fall with pink hooves in the air.

lines.zh: 水淹过鼻子，我慌乱地蹬腿。
lines.en: Water covers my snout; my legs kick wildly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.
An arrow sticks in my hind leg.
A cold wave passes and I shudder.
Empty belly; I am too weak to stand.
A thunderclap freezes my whole body.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我直往下掉。
lines.en: No ground; I fall straight down.
